title: Simulated Tiler: Prefill Optimizer and Quant Meta Presets
author: Claire Huang
description: Introduce a lightweight simulation-based "annealer" (tiler) that searches a constrained space of prefill lengths, batching shapes, and quantization metadata to generate per-tenant 'frugal templates' for default serving profiles. Motivation: tenants with heterogeneous traffic patterns benefit from tailored prefill+batch+quant presets but generating those presets manually is expensive and error-prone. The tiler performs short simulated annealing runs over historical sample traces, scores candidates by unit-econ and latency SLO violation heuristics, and exports compact presets that can be applied as tenant defaults or evaluated in the sandbox. This PR adds: 1) a CLI tool (cmd/tiler) for deterministic dry-run and export of templates; 2) an internal orchestration component (internal/econ/tiler) with a simulated annealer and scoring functions; 3) an HTTP admin endpoint (/internal/tiler/v1/preview) used by the console to preview suggested presets; 4) YAML export/import for presets-as-code; 5) feature flags to gate auto-apply; 6) telemetry and synthetic benchmarks used in CI to prevent regressions. The description below summarizes commits, changed areas, review thread, CI runs, and merge details.

review_thread: Diego Ramos (reviewer): Can you clarify how the annealer avoids pathological overfitting to the sampled trace? Request adding an explicit cross-validation pass using holdout windows.
Author (Claire Huang): Added a holdout evaluation in scoring.go and a deterministic reseed step between runs. Updated tests to assert no >5% delta between train/holdout score on synthetic traces.
Asha Menon (reviewer): The admin endpoint currently exposes candidate payloads. Add RBAC and redact any PII-like trace identifiers before returning to the console.
Author: Added RBAC checks to api/admin/tiler_handlers.go and the preview now redacts trace_id fields. Documented in ops guide.
Liam O'Connor (reviewer): CI microbench is a good guardrail but flakey on small instance shapes. Recommend increasing sample size in bench harness and mark flaky test with retry in CI.
Author: Increased iteration count and added a retry wrapper in tests/tiler/ci_helper.go. Also tuned bench thresholds to realistic machines used in CI.
Diego Ramos: Approve after the holdout test, RBAC and retry changes. +1
Asha Menon: Approve. Minor nits fixed in subsequent commit. +1
release_notes: Add simulated-tiler CLI and internal annealer to generate tenant prefill/batch/quant presets; admin preview endpoint and presets-as-code export. Opt-in only; no automatic tenant changes. Recommended for teams running large tenant fleets to prototype cost-aware defaults.
notes_for_ops: Operator steps: optional cronjob template provided in deploy/k8s/tiler-job.yaml. Tiler requires read access to recent trace samples (configured via service account). Feature flagged; to enable auto-apply (not recommended in initial rollout) see docs/operations/tiler.md.
